full_page.content:
1937, May 12 Page Two
Mr. Charles H. Chisolm
could not wait to get over but phoned first and then came over to have me send the enrollment card. You know better than I what resulted.
But why all such details? I simply want to put you "wise" against poisonous intimations regarding Rae Garland, on the part of a certain prominent party" who had a big share in the robbing of Garland of his cemetery, the Mt. Vernon Memorial Park. This of course is coming too late to save Garland his employ- ment, but if you find out the truth about him as I know it, and about said prominent party who has knocked him before, you'll realize something of what you've lost in dropping such a promising employee. But more than this, you will know what to do without hesitation if occasionally you have an opportunity to do him and me a favor.
Wishing you God's blessing, I beg to remain Very Sincerely Yours in Christ Francis Solanus Casey, O.M. Cap.
